name: Camping Mayrhofen
beschreibung: The campsite Mayrhofen is located in the centre of the well-known holiday resort of Mayrhofen in the Zillertal. It is open all year round and offers pitches for motorhomes as well as rental accommodation in the form of mobile homes. The site has a heated swimming pool and a children's playground. In the immediate vicinity are the valley stations of the Penken and Ahorn lifts. The village of Mayrhofen offers a variety of shopping options and restaurants. The campsite is suitable as a starting point for hikes and ski tours in the surrounding mountains.
